title: Receipt for custodial property.
bodyText: A written acknowledgment of delivery by a custodian constitutes a sufficient receipt and discharge for custodial property transferred to the custodian pursuant to this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§553A-8]  Receipt for custodial property.  A written acknowledgment of delivery by a custodian constitutes a sufficient receipt and discharge for custodial property transferred to the custodian pursuant to this chapter. [L 1985, c 91, pt of §1]
